strings.name: Mariah Carey
strings.summary: Carey emerged with her 1990 debut, combining melody writing, broad vocal range and layered vocal arrangements. Moving from pop ballads toward R&B and hip-hop collaboration, Butterfly and The Emancipation of Mimi marked changes in sound. Her Christmas music gained lasting cultural reach. Songwriters Hall and MusiCares honors followed as she continued recording.
